definitions.gloss: to clear away, to dispel, to relieve
definitions.explanation: To get rid of negative feelings, suspicion, or gloom. Often used with abstract nouns like stress, doubt, or frustration.

examples.japanese: {疑|うたが}いを{晴|は}らしたい。
examples.english: I want to clear away the suspicion.

examples.japanese: {運動|うんどう}をして{日|ひ}ごろの{鬱憤|うっぷん}を{晴|は}らした。
examples.english: I exercised to vent my pent-up frustration.

notes:
{晴|は}らす is a transitive verb meaning to clear away or dispel something negative.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {晴|は}れる (intransitive, to clear up — weather/mood)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ストレスを{晴|は}らす (relieve stress)
- {疑|うたが}いを{晴|は}らす (clear suspicion)
- {鬱憤|うっぷん}を{晴|は}らす (vent frustration)
- {恨|うら}みを{晴|は}らす (settle a grudge)
